+        "nested": nested,

+        "continuation_reset": bool(multi_page and nested and top_roman),

+def _map_path(
+    raw: tuple[str, ...], allowed: list[tuple[str, ...]], used: set[tuple[str, ...]],
+) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
+    if raw in allowed and raw not in used:
+        return raw
+    if len(raw) == 1:
+        matches = [path for path in allowed if path not in used and path[-1] == raw[0]]
+        if matches:
+            return matches[0]
+    return None

+def _mark_values(mark_candidate: Any) -> tuple[list[int], str | None]:
+    values, error = quality.predecessor.frozen.base.parse_mark_values(mark_candidate)
+    if error:
+        return [], error
+    if any(type(value) is not int or value <= 0 for value in values):
+        return [], "specialized_mark_value_invalid"
+    return values, None

+def normalized_matches_observation(normalized: Any, observation: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    return isinstance(normalized, dict) and normalized == observation["expected"]

+def repair_candidate(
+    full_candidate: Any,
+    mark_candidate: Any,
+    observation: dict[str, Any],
+    baseline_normalized: Any,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    family = observation["family"]
+    if family == "ambiguous":
+        return _rejection("ambiguous-layout-family", family, full_candidate, mark_candidate)
+    if normalized_matches_observation(baseline_normalized, observation):
+        return {
+            "status": "preserved",
+            "reason": "baseline-structure-and-page-facts-equal",
+            "family": family,
+            "normalized": copy.deepcopy(baseline_normalized),
+            "activations": [],
+            "warnings": [],
+            "owner_equivalence_proven": True,
+            "candidate_structure_complete": True,
+        }
+    if not isinstance(full_candidate, dict):
+        return _rejection("full-candidate-not-object", family, full_candidate, mark_candidate)
+    number = observation["question_number"]
+    if (
+        type(full_candidate.get("question_number")) is not int
+        or full_candidate["question_number"] != number
+        or type(full_candidate.get("candidate_writing_present")) is not bool
+        or type(full_candidate.get("foreign_annotation_present")) is not bool
+    ):
+        return _rejection("incomplete-candidate-scalars", family, full_candidate, mark_candidate)
+    raw_parts = full_candidate.get("visible_subparts")
+    raw_marks = full_candidate.get("visible_marks")
+    if not isinstance(raw_parts, list) or not isinstance(raw_marks, list):
+        return _rejection("incomplete-candidate-structure", family, full_candidate, mark_candidate)
+
+    printed = observation["printed_paths"]
+    score_paths = observation["score_paths"]
+    unmarked = observation["unmarked_paths"]
+    used_parts: set[tuple[str, ...]] = set()
+    for value in raw_parts:
+        raw = parse_owner_path(value, number)
+        if raw is None:
+            return _rejection("extra-or-invalid-subpart", family, full_candidate, mark_candidate)
+        mapped = _map_path(raw, printed, used_parts)
+        if mapped is None:
+            return _rejection("extra-subpart", family, full_candidate, mark_candidate)
+        used_parts.add(mapped)
+    missing_score_parts = [path for path in score_paths if path != ("question",) and path not in used_parts]
+    if missing_score_parts:
+        return _rejection("direct-structural-omission", family, full_candidate, mark_candidate)
+    missing_unmarked = [path for path in unmarked if path not in used_parts]
+
+    used_scores: set[tuple[str, ...]] = set()
+    dropped_zero = False
+    alias_used = False
+    for row in raw_marks:
+        if not isinstance(row, dict) or type(row.get("marks")) is not int:
+            return _rejection("invalid-full-mark-row", family, full_candidate, mark_candidate)
+        raw = parse_owner_path(row.get("owner"), number)
+        if raw is None:
+            return _rejection("invalid-mark-owner", family, full_candidate, mark_candidate)
+        if row["marks"] == 0:
+            mapped_unmarked = _map_path(raw, unmarked, set())
+            if mapped_unmarked is None:
+                return _rejection("zero-mark-on-score-owner", family, full_candidate, mark_candidate)
+            dropped_zero = True
+            continue
+        if row["marks"] < 0:
+            return _rejection("negative-mark-value", family, full_candidate, mark_candidate)
+        mapped = _map_path(raw, score_paths, used_scores)
+        if mapped is None:
+            return _rejection("owner-structure-not-equivalent", family, full_candidate, mark_candidate)
+        if raw == ("question",) and str(row.get("owner", "")).strip().lower() != "question":
+            alias_used = True
+        used_scores.add(mapped)
+    if used_scores != set(score_paths):
+        return _rejection("direct-mark-owner-omission", family, full_candidate, mark_candidate)
+
+    values, error = _mark_values(mark_candidate)
+    if error or len(values) != len(score_paths):
+        return _rejection(error or "specialized-mark-count-mismatch", family, full_candidate, mark_candidate)
+    normalized = {
+        "question_number": number,
+        "visible_subparts": list(observation["expected"]["visible_subparts"]),
+        "visible_marks": [
+            {"owner": canonical_owner(path), "marks": value}
+            for path, value in zip(score_paths, values)
+        ],
+        "candidate_writing_present": full_candidate["candidate_writing_present"],
+        "foreign_annotation_present": full_candidate["foreign_annotation_present"],
+    }
+    activations = ["specialized-mark-owner-equivalence"]
+    if missing_unmarked:
+        activations.append("explicit-unmarked-instruction-owner")
+    if dropped_zero:
+        activations.append("unmarked-zero-mark-removal")
+    if alias_used:
+        activations.append("whole-question-owner-alias")
+    if observation["features"]["repeated_children"]:
+        activations.append("hierarchical-owner-path-reconstruction")
+    if observation["features"]["continuation_reset"] or (
+        observation["features"]["unmarked"] and any(len(path) > 1 for path in score_paths)
+    ):
+        activations.append("page-aware-roman-owner-reset")
+    return {
+        "status": "accepted",
+        "reason": "owner-equivalence-proven-from-observable-layout",
+        "family": family,
+        "normalized": normalized,
+        "activations": sorted(set(activations)),
+        "warnings": ["raw-candidate-preserved", "layout-family-repair-accepted"],
+        "owner_equivalence_proven": True,
+        "candidate_structure_complete": True,
+    }

+def _rejection(reason: str, family: str, full_candidate: Any, mark_candidate: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    del full_candidate, mark_candidate
+    activation = {
+        "direct-structural-omission": "direct-structural-omission-rejection",
+        "direct-mark-owner-omission": "direct-structural-omission-rejection",
+        "extra-subpart": "extra-subpart-rejection",
+        "extra-or-invalid-subpart": "extra-subpart-rejection",
+        "owner-structure-not-equivalent": "owner-equivalence-rejection",
+    }.get(reason, "owner-equivalence-rejection")
+    return {
+        "status": "rejected",
+        "reason": reason,
+        "family": family,
+        "normalized": None,
+        "activations": [activation],
+        "warnings": ["raw-candidate-preserved", f"layout-family-repair-rejected:{reason}"],
+        "owner_equivalence_proven": False,
+        "candidate_structure_complete": False,
+    }

+def evaluate_bundle(bundle: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    observation = bundle["observation"]
+    repaired = repair_candidate(
+        bundle["full_candidate"], bundle["mark_candidate"], observation,
+        bundle["baseline_normalized"],
+    )
+    checks = quality.predecessor.batch.checks(repaired["normalized"], observation["expected"])
+    passed = all(checks.values()) and repaired["status"] in {"accepted", "preserved"}
+    false_override = bool(bundle["before_pass"] and not passed)
+    false_accept = bool(passed and not repaired["owner_equivalence_proven"])
+    return {
+        "question_id": bundle["question_id"],
+        "population": bundle["population"],
+        "family": repaired["family"],
+        "features": observation["features"],
+        "before_pass": bundle["before_pass"],
+        "after_pass": passed,
+        "status": repaired["status"],
+        "reason": repaired["reason"],
+        "checks": checks,
+        "before_structure": bundle["baseline_normalized"],
+        "after_structure": repaired["normalized"],
+        "repair_activations": repaired["activations"],
+        "warnings": repaired["warnings"],
+        "owner_equivalence_proven": repaired["owner_equivalence_proven"],
+        "candidate_structure_complete": repaired["candidate_structure_complete"],
+        "false_override": false_override,

+    }

+def canonical_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:

+def sha256_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:

+def parse_owner_path(value: Any, question_number: int | None = None) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
+    if not isinstance(value, str):

+    whole = re.fullmatch(r"question(?:([0-9]+))?", text)
+    if whole:
+        if whole.group(1) is not None and question_number is not None and int(whole.group(1)) != question_number:
+            return None
+        return ("question",)
+    parenthesized = re.fullmatch(r"(?:\([a-z]+\))+", text)
+    if parenthesized:
+        return tuple(re.findall(r"\(([a-z]+)\)", text))
+    nested = re.fullmatch(r"([a-z]+)\(([a-z]+)\)", text)
+    if nested:
+        return nested.group(1), nested.group(2)
+    if re.fullmatch(r"[a-z]+", text):
+        return (text,)
+    return None

+def canonical_owner(path: tuple[str, ...]) -> str:

+    value = path[0]

+    if features["repeated_children"]:
